demos.name: Privilege Bulk Users LAB
demos.description: Register users for PingOne Privilege by API, in bulk: a guide to the two routes (PingOne API, Privilege console API) and a runnable lab with plan, typed-count apply and verify, 429 back-off, and six Mock scenarios. Mock by default; Real is owner-run.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 7817; npm run doctor checks it). Or: HOST_PORT=7817 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock needs no setup. Real is refused until the owner sets PRIVILEGE_BULK_MODE=real in the lab's own .env beside docker-compose.yml. No catalog id yet: the owner assigns one with the board row. The composeFile is relative to the folder the demo repos sit in.
